model: Marker images decoded asynchronously and were fetched at low priority, so the first paint of a new marker could be an empty box. They now decode before that paint. Cluster icon swaps already wait for the next image to load.

noise.rule: 18 is the number of regional centers. Empty regions are not drawn, so a live frame is at or under that ceiling. Sync decode removes the empty paint after bytes arrive; it does not hide network wait. Not a sampled paint trace.
